attrs.author: Mistral
attrs.summary: Mistral's Ministral 3 14B dense model with vision encoder. The largest model in the Ministral 3 family, Ministral 3 14B offers frontier capabilities and performance comparable to its larger Mistral Small 3.2 24B counterpart. A powerful and efficient language model with vision capabilities. This model is the instruct post-trained version, fine-tuned for instruction tasks, making it ideal for chat and instruction based use cases.
